Lia (Design): Quick design review — rollout timeline mock is up. Main focuses: canary snapshot cards, batch-size label, undo affordance, and compressing version history for long-lived services. Screenshot + prototype link attached. Sam (FE): Prefer inline undo (micro-toast anchored to timeline item) over a persistent banner. Banner clutters in narrow layouts and is easy to miss on mobile. :thinking_face: Natalie (PM): Agree with inline undo. Also we need copy clarity: users must know undo only reassigns traffic, not revert code/config. Draft copy: "Undo canary — revert traffic allocation to previous variant (no code changes)." Thoughts? Reza (A11y): +1. Also requires aria-live for the toast and descriptive aria-labels on timeline nodes. Quick snippet: ```html
Canary reverted to v2.2
``` Lia (Design): For visuals: thinking a compact "snapshot" chip next to the timeline tick showing timestamp + percent. Click to expand details (metrics, compare, actions). Expanded actions: Compare | Rollback | Undo (temporary). Placement ideas? Sam (FE): Snapshot chip right of the tick works and is easiest to wire up. Need to ensure 44px minimum hit target and avoid overlap with model/route badges. Also watch z-index with timeline hover state. Natalie (PM): Copy nuance: use "Rollback & redeploy" only when a rollback triggers a new deploy; otherwise label as "Rollback". We should show consequence text under the action. Reza (A11y): Keyboard flow must be: timeline tick -> snapshot chip -> expanded menu. Menu items must be actual buttons (not links) and announce state changes. Use role=menu and aria-expanded on the chip. Also ensure focus trap doesn't break global nav. Lia (Design): Good call. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for the undo confirmation animation. We want subtle motion on expand only. Sam (FE): I'll prototype a11y-first markup and a tiny CSS animation tomorrow. Adding e2e tests for keyboard nav + screenreader announcements. Natalie (PM): Thanks — @Sam can you add two copy variants (short/verbose) in the prototype? @Reza can you review the aria strings after the proto? Aim for dev-preview by Tuesday. deploy-bot: New staging preview deployed: https://ci.redwood/example/1843102222 — includes timeline snapshots and canary undo flow. Sam (FE): grabbing the preview now. :eyes: Reza (A11y): Quick nit after a glance — panel icon contrast low on dark theme, fails 3:1 for small icons. Also ensure color-only indicators have textual equivalents. Lia (Design): Noted, will iterate in Figma (increasing icon weight and adding text fallback). I'll ping when updated. :thumbsup: Sam (FE): I'll file a follow-up ticket for the keyboard tests and the contrast tweak. Natalie (PM): Thanks team — this is actionable. Will track rollout E2E and copy sign-off.
